File Format="vip"
Format Version="2014"
Display Name="VI Analyzer Results to Checkstyle XML Format"


[Description]
Description="Formats VI Analyzer results into a Checkstyle-compatible XML format.  This is useful for integrating VI Analyzer tests into a continuous integration environment.  CI plugins that can consume and track Checkstyle results can now also be used with VI Analyzer for static analysis of VI code.\0A\0AThe results take into account VI Analyzer test rankings and set Checkstyle severity accordingly (Low = Info, Normal = Warning, High = Error)."
Summary="Converts VI Analyzer results to Checkstyle XML format"
License="Apache 2.0"
Copyright="Copyright (c) 2018, National Instruments"

Vendor="National Instruments"
URL="github.com/LabVIEW-DCAF/VIA-Checkstyle"
Packager="NI Systems Engineering"

Release Notes="-Fixed bug where special characters were not always properly escaped for XML\0A-Fixed bug where test ranking was not always reported accurately"
